read.thesis: Q1 organic revenue fell 1.5% with DSA and RMS both declining and non-GAAP margin down to 16.3% from 19.1%; guidance reaffirmed on organic and non-GAAP EPS, with no evidence yet of supply cuts or utilisation turning.

triggers.label: Organic revenue -1.5%, RMS -5.5%
triggers.quote: Organic revenue decreased by 5.5%, due primarily to lower revenue for small research models in North America, as well as for large research models.

triggers.label: Non-GAAP DSA margin 23.9% → 21.0%
triggers.quote: The non-GAAP operating margin decrease was primarily driven by higher study-related direct costs associated with large-model sourcing and study starts.

triggers.label: Non-GAAP EPS $10.80–$11.30 held
triggers.quote: The Company is reaffirming its 2026 organic revenue and non-GAAP earnings per share guidance

guidance.quote: the Company is reducing its 2026 reported revenue outlook by approximately 50 basis points to reflect recent changes in assumptions for foreign exchange rates

red_flags.label: Non-GAAP margin down 280bps
red_flags.quote: On a non-GAAP basis, the first-quarter operating margin decreased to 16.3% from 19.1% in the first quarter of 2025

red_flags.label: Reported revenue guidance cut, CEO transition
red_flags.quote: higher stock-based compensation expense related largely to executive transition
